context: One route per PR: Benchmark, Platform, Query, Home, ResultDetail. Each adopts the picking owner and the shared tray, and takes the single label 'Compare selected', disabled below two picks with the reason in the tray. ResultDetail's treatment is an open question - it may keep a single hand-off rather than a selection affordance - and must be decided before its PR, not during.
description:
Five entry points, four labels, four selection owners: 'Compare ->' (Home.tsx:1098), 'Select 2 comparable results' (BenchmarkIndex.tsx:670, PlatformIndex.tsx:640), 'Compare 0 runs' (Compare), 'Compare (need 2+)' (Query.tsx:818), 'Compare this result' (ResultDetail.tsx:266).

Each route migrates in its own PR so any one can be reverted alone. The old path keeps working until the last route lands.

anti_patterns.dont: Migrate Query and the Compare builder onto the shared fixed tray
anti_patterns.instead: INSTEAD stop tray adoption at BenchmarkIndex and PlatformIndex and share a copy helper instead
anti_patterns.why: Query's tray is inline and never occluded anything, the builder is itself the compare surface so a sticky springboard duplicates its own launch control, and accommodating fixed, inline and full-page layouts turns CompareTray into a mode-heavy abstraction

anti_patterns.instead: settle it before starting that route
anti_patterns.why: it is an open product question, not an implementation detail

anti_patterns.instead: make worktree-create BRANCH=... WORKTREE_PATH=... then make agent-write-preflight
anti_patterns.why: AGENTS.md makes the primary clone read-only for agents

anti_patterns.dont: migrate several routes in one PR
anti_patterns.why: a shared-tray regression would otherwise require reverting every route at once

anti_patterns.instead: leave it to rx-ux-19 behind its parity gate
anti_patterns.why: retirement needs the parity evidence, not just a working replacement

preserves.behavior: /results/compare?ids=<one> pins that run and opens the builder (Compare.tsx:184+); ?ids=<a,b> renders a comparison. Both are live contracts (ResultDetail.tsx:266, e2e/routes/compare.spec.ts:58, compare-entrypoints.spec.ts:76).
Compare's candidate table stays until rx-ux-19
Compare's recovery rule that a multi-selection URL stays multi after a one-result recovery, so it does not collapse into the single-result builder (Compare.tsx:331-350).
Disabled reasons are exposed via aria-describedby (PlatformIndex.tsx:961, Query.tsx:900), not an accessible-name suffix. Follow the shipped pattern.
Each unmigrated route keeps working until its own PR lands
